rust_summary: `native_upgrade_block_state(name, props, data_version)`: a block state written before the 1.13 flattening, upgraded to its 1.13 name and properties as the datafixers do it.
doc_summary: `native_upgrade_block_state(name, props, data_version)` gives a block state (`name` and its `props` as `key`, `value` pairs) as the datafixers upgrade it when it was written at `data_version`: a state from before DataVersion 1519 (1.13, the flattening) comes out with its 1.13 name and properties, from the `BlockStateData` table; any other state, or one the table doesn't know, comes back as it is. The numeric ids of the oldest chunks are not read. Bundles need "hooks": @API:upgrade_block_state@.
